contentEn:
How much does a bathroom renovation cost per square foot in Vancouver in 2026? Based on 23 real Reno Stars projects across Metro Vancouver, the answer is $200 to $560 per square foot depending on scope, property type and finish level.

What Drives Cost Per Square Foot in Vancouver

Three factors determine where your project lands. Scope: a basic update costs far less per square foot than a full gut that moves plumbing. Finish: a mid-range quartz-countertop reno sits in a different tier than a curbless shower with heated floors. Property type: a condo bathroom has different constraints than a basement bath in a Richmond townhouse. Labour is roughly 55–65% of total cost; materials 35–45%.

All figures are contract prices including labour, materials and permits.

Why Small Bathrooms Cost More Per Square Foot

The minimum viable cost for any Vancouver bathroom renovation in 2026 is roughly $12,000–$14,000 regardless of size — because plumbers, electricians and tilers charge minimum call-out fees. These fixed trade costs of $8,000–$12,000 are a larger share of a small project. A 45-square-foot Vancouver condo bath cost $311–$356/sq ft. A 160-square-foot Burnaby two-bathroom renovation ran $162–$187/sq ft. Larger bathrooms spread minimum costs over more area, reducing per-square-foot cost.

Permit Requirements in Greater Vancouver

Most Metro Vancouver bathroom renovations do not need a building permit if structural elements, plumbing locations and fire separations are unchanged. Renovation permits ($400–$1,200) cover new tile, vanity and flooring. Moving plumbing fixtures requires a full building permit. Strata approval is mandatory for all condominiums and townhouses in BC, adding 4–8 weeks. Reno Stars handles both as part of every project agreement.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average bathroom renovation cost per square foot in Vancouver 2026?

Based on 23 Reno Stars projects: $200–$350/sq ft for mid-range; $450–$560/sq ft for luxury with curbless showers and premium finishes. Condo baths under 50 sq ft often exceed $300/sq ft because minimum trade costs are spread across fewer square feet.

Why do small bathrooms cost more per square foot?

Fixed minimum trade costs ($8,000–$12,000) are a larger share of a small project's total. A 45-square-foot Vancouver condo bath was $311–$356/sq ft; a 160-square-foot Burnaby two-bath was $162–$187/sq ft.

Does Vancouver's climate affect bathroom renovation cost?

Yes. Higher waterproofing standards, mold-resistant backer board and enhanced ventilation are mandatory in Vancouver's wet climate, adding $800–$2,000 to the project but protecting homes from moisture damage common in older properties with inadequate ventilation.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in Vancouver?

Three to five weeks from demolition to final inspection for a standard bath. Condo renovations may take longer due to strata approval and restricted work hours. Multi-bathroom projects done together take five to eight weeks.

Is bathroom renovation worth the cost for resale?

Bathroom renovations in Vancouver typically recoup 60–80% of cost in increased property value. An $18,000–$22,000 mid-range renovation can add $25,000–$40,000 to assessed value, making it one of the highest-ROI improvements in Metro Vancouver.

什麼影響每平方英尺成本

為何小浴室每平方英尺成本更高

2026年溫哥華任何洗手間裝修的最低可行成本約為12,000至14,000加元，無論面積大小——因為水管工、電工和瓷磚工都收取最低上門費用。這些8,000至12,000加元的固定人工成本，在小型項目中所佔比例更高。溫哥華45平方英尺的公寓浴室每平方英尺為311至356加元；本拿比160平方英尺的雙浴室裝修每平方英尺為162至187加元。

大溫哥華許可證要求

如果不大溫哥華各市的洗手間裝修不改變結構構件、管道位置和防火隔離，則不需要建築許可證。裝修許可證（400至1,200加元）涵蓋新瓷磚、洗手櫃和地板。更換管道裝置需要全面建築許可證。BC省所有柏文和聯排別墅必須獲得分契批准，將時間表延長4至8週。聚星裝修作為每個項目協議的一部分處理這兩項事項。

常見問題

2026年溫哥華洗手間裝修每平方英尺平均成本是多少？

根據23個聚星裝修項目：中檔裝修每平方英尺200至350加元；豪華裝修每平方英尺450至560加元。50平方英尺以下的公寓浴室通常超過每平方英尺300加元。

為何小浴室每平方英尺成本更高？

固定的最低人工成本（8,000至12,000加元）在小型項目總成本中所佔比例更高。溫哥華45平方英尺的公寓浴室每平方英尺為311至356加元；本拿比160平方英尺的雙浴室裝修每平方英尺為162至187加元。

溫哥華的氣候會影響洗手間裝修成本嗎？

是的。較高的防水標準、防霉襯板和增強通風是溫哥華潮濕氣候的強制要求，額外增加800至2,000加元，但能保護房屋免受潮濕損壞。

溫哥華洗手間裝修需要多長時間？

標準洗手間裝修從拆除到最終檢查通常需要三至五週。柏文裝修可能因分契批准和工作時間限制而需要更長時間。多間浴室裝修同時進行通常需要五至八週。

洗手間裝修值得轉售嗎？

溫哥華洗手間裝修通常能收回成本的60%至80%作為房產增值。造價18,000至22,000加元的中檔裝修可為溫哥華房屋評估價值增加25,000至40,000加元。
